commit.message: Remove storage resources from k8s overlays in all environments
Update storage configs and add storage resources to k8s overlays
Fix typo in proxy_intercept_errors setting in kustomization.yaml for production and viewsonic overlays
Add labels and patches for various Kubernetes resources in kustomization files for dev, prod, stage, and viewsonic environments
Add CI/CD workflow for production deployment with authentication and Docker build steps

Refactor Kubernetes manifests to standardize naming conventions, update volume mounts for environment variables, and adjust HorizontalPodAutoscaler settings. Changed service type to ClusterIP and updated image tags across various overlays for consistency.
Update HorizontalPodAutoscaler configurations across production, staging, and viewsonic overlays to set the correct name and reduce scale down stabilization window from 60 to 30 seconds.

Refactor deployment workflow to enhance input parameters and streamline image updates. Added new environment variables for image, SHA, commit message, and actor. Updated deployment and cronjob configurations in Kubernetes manifests. Improved Slack notification formatting for deployment status.
